tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// dus 'khor thugs dkyil gyi mngon rtogs bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo gu ru kā la tsakrā ya/ na mo mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i thugs kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa sngon du song nas/ bdud rtsi ri lu khar bcug la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥham̐ kṣaḥpradzño pa ya ādma ka kā ya wāktsitta dzñā nā dhi pa te/ ma ma kā ya wāktsitta dzñā na badzrī badzra a mri ta swa bhā waṃ ku ru ku ru/ skandha dhā twā ya ta naṃ niḥdha ga naṃḥ swa bhā wa swā hā/ zhes pas lus ngag yid dag par bsgoms nas/ gtsug tor du ham̐ las rdo rje zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgoms la/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas lus yongs su dag par bsams nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ zhes brjod do// de nas dpral bar oṃ las 'od dpag med dkar po/ mgrin par āḥlas rin chen 'byung ldan dmar po/ snying gar hūm̐ las don yod grub pa nag po/ lte bar hoḥlas rnam par snang mdzad ser po/ gtsug tor du ham̐ las mi bskyod pa ljang gu/ gsang bar kṣaḥlas rdo rje sems dpa' sngon po ste rigs drug bkod nas/ oṃ hraḥsarba ast+ra rā dza mā ra kle sha anta ka ra/ badzra tikṣ+ṇa duḥkhatstshe da ma ma ka raṃ/ bi sho dha ya swā hā/ zhes pas mngon par bsngags la/ lag pa dag par byas te/ phan tshun mnyes nas gshibs te steng du phyogs pa'i g.yon pa'i mthe'u chung gi rtsa ba'i tshigs nas brtsams te mthe bo'i tshigs kyi bar la/ a i ṛ u l̥ a e ar/ o al/ ha ya ra wa la rnams dgod cing g.yas pa'i mthe bong steng gi tshigs nas brtsams te/ lā wā rā yā hā/ āl au ār ai ā/ l̥̄ ū ṝ ī ā rnams bkod nas thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du/ g.yon du zla ba dang g.yas su nyi ma dbus su hūm̐ sngon po rnams bsgoms nas rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/

gtsug tor nas rkang pa'i sen mo'i bar gyi lus kyi cha shas rnams la reg cing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥham̐ kṣaḥkā ya wāktsitta dzñā na a dhi pa te badzra kā ya/ ma ma kā ya wāktsitta dzñā na badzri badzra kā ya swa bhā waṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod pas rigs drug pa'i rang bzhin gyi lus su gyur par bsgoms la// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra kā ya swa bhā wa ādma ko3 haṃ zhes brjod do// de nas thal mo sbyar ba'i mthe bong snying khar reg ste/ oṃ hrilāṃ hṛ da yā ya na maḥ zhes brjod do// de bzhin du mgrin par/ oṃ hūm̐ gṛ wā ya swā hā/ mgo bor/ oṃ hrara'am̐ shi ra se bau phaṭa/ yan lag thams cad la/ oṃ hrīṃ ka ba tsā ya hūm̐/ mig la/ oṃ hrām̐ ne trā wa ṣa ṭa/ mtheb mdzub kyis phyogs thams cad du se gol gtogs shing*/ oṃ hrāḥ.ast+rā ya phaṭa/ ces brjod pas yan lag drug dag par bya'o// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya gṛ wa si raḥka wa tsa ne tra ast+ra badzra ṣa ḍām̐ ga swa bhā wa ādma ko3haṃ zhes brjod do// de ltar rigs drug dang yan lag drug rim pa bzhin yab dang yum mo// de ltar bdag nyid bsrungs nas rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas 'og tu ye shes kyi me ljang gu 'bar ba steng du sngon po/ shar dang shar lhor nag po/ lho dang lho nub tu dmar po/ nub dang nub byang du ser po/ byang dang byang shar du dkar po// 'bar ba'i ye shes kyi me dpung du gyur nas/ slar yang 'od 'phros pas de'i dbus su rdo rje'i gur yangs shing rgya che ba steng mda'i drwa ba dang*/ 'og rtse mo thur du bstan pa'i mdung gis gtams par gyur par bsgoms nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ raḥ badzra tsand+ra sūrya rā hu kā la agne kā ya wāktsitta dzñā na badzra prā kā rā na ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod do// de nas bsod nams kyi tshogs bsag pa'i phyir/ rang gi snying ga'i nang du pam̐ las padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du/

a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa dmigs pa las 'od 'phros pas rang gi sdig pa sbyangs/ dbang po dang ba spu'i bu ga nas 'phros pas/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo spyan drangs la na mo gu ru bhyaḥdang*/ na maḥshrī kā la tsakrā ya maṇḍa le bhyaḥs phyag 'tshal nas rang gi snying ga na sa bon so so las bskyed pa'i lha mo bcu gnyis kyis mchod par bya ste/ oṃ tsatshadzadzhanyā badzra gandhe gandha artsatsa naṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ tsatshadzadzhanyā badzra mā le mā la artsatsa naṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā// oṃ ṭaṭhaḍaḍhaṇā badzra dhū pe dhā pa/ artsatsa naṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ ṭaṭhaḍaḍhaṇā badzra pra dī pe pra dī pa/ artsatsa naṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ paphababhamā badzra a mṛ ta badzra nai wi dye artsatsa naṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ paphababhamā badzra akṣa te badzra akṣa ta pha la artsatsa naṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ tathadadhanā badzra lā sye bast+ra ā bha ra ṇa pū dzāṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā// oṃ tathadadhanā badzra ha sye gha ṇa ṭa ā darsha pū dzī ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ kakhagaghangā badzra bā dye bā dya pū dzīṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ kakhagaghangā badzra nri tye nṛ tya pū dzāṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ sanyapaṣashaྈkā badzra gī te gī ta pū dzāṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ sanyapaṣashaྈkā badzra ka me sarba buddha bo dhi sa twā nāṃ kro dha a dī nāṃ badzra su ra ta pū dzāṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes pa rnams kyis mchod nas sdig pa dpag med byas pa rnams/ so so nyid du bshags par bgyi/ rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyis dge ba dpag med gang byas pa// de rnams kun la rjes su yi rang bgyi zhing sdig bral byang chub spyod la rjes su zhugs par zhu// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun srid pa'i 'jigs pa 'joms pa rnams la byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// bdag gis ji srid len 'gyur lus 'bul sems can ma lus don phyir rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shog

/ces lan gsum brjod nas sems bskyed pa dang*/ bsam pa rnam par dag pa dang*/ bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa dang bral ba'i rtsa ba gsum dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa bcu dang*/ tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi dang*/ bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi bsgom par bya zhing mi dge ba bcu dang*/ sgrib pa lnga dang*/ nyon mongs pa bzhi dang*/ zag pa bzhi po spangs bar bsgoms nas/ tshogs kyi zhing gshegs su gsol lo// bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags nas/ ye shes kyi tshogs bsag pa'i phyir/ dngos med dngos po med pa'i phyir// de ltar dngos po dngos med 'gyur// de phyir dngos po dmigs su med// ces brjod cing don dran par byas nas/ slar yang brtan pa dang g.yo ba'i dngos po thams cad la dmigs te/ phyi'i snod bcud thams cad lus la thim zhing*/ lus kyi me'i khams chus sa brnal bar byas shing*/ sa'ang chu la thim ste/ chu rlung gis bskams nas/ rlung yang nam mkha' la thim ste/ rnam par shes pa'ang stong pa nyid du rjes su zhugs nas yul dang yul can dang bral ba'i stong pa nyid du bsgoms nas/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ādma ko3haṃ zhes brjod do// de nas mtshan ma med pa'i don dran par byas la/ oṃ a ni mitta dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ zhes brjod do// yang smon pa med pa'i don dran par byas nas/ oṃ a pra ṇi hi ta dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ zhes brjod do// de nas chos thams cad gdod ma nas ma grub pa mngon par 'dus ma byas pa'i don dran par byas la/ oṃ a nā bhi saṃskā ra dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ zhes brjod do// ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa'o// de nas rten bskyed pa'i phyir sngon gyi smon lam gyi mthus stong pa nyid kyi ngang las hrīḥlas nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor ljang gu'i dbus su chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa gdengs kha gyen du phyogs pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du hūm̐ yam̐ hūm̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po gzhu'i rnam par rgyar dpag tshad 'bum phrag bzhi pa/

de'i steng du hūm̐ ram̐ hūm̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum rgyar dpag tshad 'bum phrag gsum pa/ de'i steng du hūm̐ kham̐ hūm̐ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po rgyar dpag tshad 'bum phrag gnyis pa/ de'i steng du hūm̐ lam̐ hūm̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi pa rgyar dpag tshad 'bum phrag gcig pa thams cad kyi steng 'og sna tshogs kyi rdo rjes mtshan pa rim pa bzhin rlung yab dang*/ bkra shis dang*/ padma dang*// 'khor los mtshan pa bsgoms nas/ oṃ hām̐ yām̐ rām̐ wām̐ lām̐ badzra ā kā sha bā yu/ te dza/ u da ka pṛ thī wī/ badzra swa bhā wa/ pañtsa dhā ta bo badzra maṇḍal ku ru ku ru swā hā zhes brjod do// de'i steng du mam̐ las ri rab steng gi cha la dpag tshad stong phrag lnga bcu pa bsam pa'i steng du kṣaḥlas padma rgyar dpag tshad stong phrag nyi shu rtsa lnga pa bsams la/ oṃ kṣaḥbadzra bi shwa padmaṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā zhes brjod do// de'i lte bar ham̐ las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rgyar dpag tshad stong phrag bco brgyad sum cha dang bcas pa bsams nas/ oṃ ham̐ badzra tsand+rā sa naṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā zhes brjod do// de'i steng du a las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor zla ba'i tshad dang mnyam pa bsams la/ oṃ āḥbadzra sūryā sa na ku ru ku ru swā hā zhes brjod do// de'i steng du am̐ las sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor nag po nyi ma'i tshad dang mnyam pa bsams nas/ oṃ am̐ rā hu ā sa naṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā zhes brjod do// de nas de thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa las ham̐kṣamalawaraya zhes pa'i sa bon du gyur cing de'ang yongs su gyur pa las/ rten gyi dkyil 'khor du gyur te de'ang phyi rol ye shes kyi me 'bar bas yongs su bskor ba'i rdo rje phreng ba'i nang du nam mkha' dang rlung*/ de nyid kyi mtshams su dur khrod chen po brgyad dang*/ de'i nang du me dang chu dang sa'i khor yug gis bskor zhing*/

de'i dbus su padma'i lte ba la gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ phyi nas rim pa bzhin dkar po dmar po nag po'i rtsig pa rim pa gsum dang ldan pa 'og 'dod yon gyi snam bu dkar po dang*/ steng du rin po che'i pha gu dang*/ drwa ba dang*/ drwa ba phyed pa dang*/ ba ku lī dang kra ma shīrṣas spras pa la zla ba dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ dril bu dang*/ me long dang rnga yab la sogs pas brgyan pa/ sgo rnams kyi steng du rta babs bang rim gsum gsum dang ldan pa'i rim pa re re zhing mchod pa'i lha mo rnams dang ldan pa/ sgrib pa med cing 'od zer kun tu 'khrug pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dkyil du padma ljang gu 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar ham̐ las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du a las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du am̐ las sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor de'i steng du ham̐ las dus kyi me'i dkyil 'khor rnams bsgom mo// de'i phyi rol rdo rje'i phreng ba bzhi pas bskor ba'i ngos re rer shar gyi la ral gri/ lho'i la rin po che/ byang gi la padma/ nub kyi la 'khor los mtshan pa/ ka ba bcu drug gis rdo rje'i gdung brgyad bteg pa mig mangs ris su phub pa'i dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje nor bu rin po che'i tog gis mtshan pa/ ka ba'i bar gyi phyogs bzhir padma dang nyi ma'i gdan dang grwa bzhir padma dang zla ba'i gdan te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phar ma'o// de'i phyi rol gyi rim pa dang*/ grwa bzhir padma dang zla ba'i gdan re re ste sems dpa' sems ma'i 'phar ma'o// de'i phyi rol sgo bzhir padma dang nyi ma'i gdan bzhi bsgom pa ni khro bo'i 'phar ma'o// de ltar gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa bskyed nas/ oṃ bhrūm̐ bi shwa kā ya badzra/ badzra kū ṭa ga raṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā zhes brjod do// rten bskyed pa'o// de nas brten pa lha bskyed pa'i phyir gdan dbus ma'i steng du/

a i ṛ u l̥/ a e ar o al/ ha ya ra wa la am̐ rnams g.yon skor dang*/ lā wā rā yā hā/ āl au ār ai ā l̥̄ ū ṝ ī ā aḥrnams g.yas skor du dmigs la/ de dag mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis su blta'o// oṃ de zhu ba las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du bsgom zhing de la me long lta bu'i ye shes su blta'o// de'i steng du/ lla wwa yya ḍḍa ḍhaḍha/ lla wwa rar yya haha/ ssa nypanypa ṣṣa shsha ྈkaྈka tta thatha dda dha dha nna/ ppa phapha bba bha bha mma/ ṭṭa ṭhaṭha ḍḍa ḍhaḍha ṇṇa/ tstsa tshtsha dzdza dzhadzha nynya/ kka khkha gga ghagha ngnga/ rnams g.yos skor dang*/ ngagha ga kha ka nya dzha dza tsha tsa/ ṇa ḍha ḍa ṭha ṭa/ ma bha ba pha pa/ na dha da tha ta/ ྈka sha ṣa nypa sa/ ha ya ra wa la/ ḍha ḍa ya wa la rnams g.yon skor du dmigs la/ de dag dpe byad bzang po brgyad cur blta'o// aḥde zhu ba las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du bsgom zhing*/ de mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes su blta'o// de'i bar du hum̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hum̐ gis mtshan pa bsgom pa ni so sor rtog pa'i ye shes blta'o// de gsum 'dres pa las byung ba'i gong bu hi yig gis mtshan pa bsgom pa ni bya ba grub pa'i ye shes su blta'o// de yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das kyi sku yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa bsgom ste/ de'ang sku mdog nag po zhal bzhi/ phyag nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa/ zhabs gnyis pa rtsa zhal nag po mche ba gtsigs pa/ g.yas dmar po chags pa dang bcas pa/ g.yon dkar po rab tu zhi ba/ rgyab zhal ser po ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa'i tshul/ spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa ral pa'i cod pan spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i 'og na zla tshes dang thod pa skam po lngas brgyan pa/ zhal gdangs pa mche ba gtsigs pa'o// mgrin pa gsum pa'i dbus gnag g.yas dmar/ g.yon dkar ba'o// g.yas g.yon du phrag pa gsum gsum ni dang po nag po/ gnyis pa dmar po/ gsum pa dkar po'o// de bzhin du dpung pa drug drug gi dang po gnyis nag po/

bar pa gnyis dmar po/ tha ma gnyis dkar po'o// de bzhin du g.yas g.yon du lag ngar bcu gnyis bcu gnyis te dang po bzhi nag po/ bar pa bzhi dmar po/ tha ma bzhi dkar po/ phyag mgo nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa'i dang por brgyad gnag bar pa brgyad dmar/ tha ma brgyad dkar po'o// sor mo lnga lnga'i mthe bo ser/ mdzub mo dkar/ gung mo dmar/ srin lag gnag mthe'u chung ljang ba'o// sor mo re la tshigs gsum gsum ste/ dang po'i phreng nag po'o// gnyis pa dmar po/ gsum pa dkar po'o// zhabs g.yas dmar po brkyang pas 'dod pa'i lha'i bdud sdig can dmar po gdong gcig pa/ lag pa bzhi pa g.yas pa gnyis kyis mda' dang zhags pa/ g.yon pa gnyis kyis gzhu dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ chung ma dga' ma dang lhan cig mnan pa/ g.yon pa dkar po bskum pas drag po dkar po gdong gcig pa/ lag pa bzhi pa g.yas gnyis rtse gsum dang cang te'u/ g.yon pa gnyis kyis thod pa dang kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin pa chung ma u ma dang lhan cig mnan pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i cod pan can du bskyed nas/ phyag rgya rnams kyis gdab par bya ste/ de'ang oṃ ham̐ haḥs rdo rje'i rna rgyan rnams bskyed nas/ bā ma dakṣi ṇa karṇaṇa yor/ badzra kuṇḍa li hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa ces brjod pas rna ba rnams la rna rgyan gyi rgyas btab par bsam mo// tshul de bzhin 'og ma rnams la'ang shes par byas nas/ oṃ am̐ aḥkaṭyāṃ kaṇṭhe/ badzra me kha lā/ badzra kaṇṭhi ke hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa kyis ska rags dang mgul rgyan dang*/ oṃ a ā bā ma dakṣi ṇa ka ra yor badzra ru tsa kau hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa ces pa lag gdub rnams dang*/ oṃ ha hā bhā ma dakṣi ṇa pā da yor badzra nū pu re hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa ces pa rkang gdub gnyis dang*/ oṃ ham̐ bam̐ pañtsa a kā ra ma hā shyu n+ya swa bhā wa ma hā badzra shi ro ma ṇi shir si/ sarba aṃ ge bhā shma hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa kyis gtsug gi nor bu dang*/ thal chen gyi rgya dang*/ oṃ am̐ ardha nā rī shwa ra badzra ardha tsand+ra badzra pa ḍa urdhe hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa kyis zla ba phyed pa dang*/

dar dpyangs dang*/ oṃ a aḥ am̐ sarba swa rai ka trī swa ra swa bhā wa badzra ya dzño pa bī tā skandhe hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa kyis mchod phyir thogs dang*/ oṃ kṣaḥdurdānta a bhi mā nakṣa yaṃ ka ra/ byā ghrā tsarma ka ṭau hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa kyis stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs dang*/ oṃ ham̐ kṣaḥtrīṃ shat+s+wa ra sapta ti hra swa dīrgha bya ñdza na swa bhā wa dai tyaṃ ku la sha ta si ro bhir muṇḍa mā la skan dhā ba laṃ bi ni skandhe hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa kyis lha ma yin gyi mgo bo brgya'i do shal dang*/ oṃ ha hi hṛ hu hl̥ pañtsa skandha bi shuddha swa bhā we shi ra si ka pā la ma le hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa kyis thod pa skam po'i cod pan rnams kyi rgyas gdab bo// denas phyag mtshan rnams dgod pa'i phyir/ oṃ kṣ+raḥs rdo rje bskyed nas phyag g.yas kyi dang por bzung bar bsgoms la/ badzra kro dha badzra hum̐ phaṭa kyis phyag g.yas kyis dang por rdo rje dang*// oṃ kṣ+raḥbadzra khaḍga hum̐ phaṭa kyis gnyis par ral gri/ oṃ kṣ+raḥbadzra tri shū la hum̐ phaṭa kyis gsum par rtse gsum/ oṃ kṣ+raḥbadzra kart+ta ri hum̐ phaṭa kyis bzhi par gri gug oṃ kṣ+raḥbadzra bā ṇa hum̐ phaṭa kyis lnga par mda'/ oṃ kṣ+raḥbadzra aṃ ku sha hum̐ phaṭa kyis drug par lcags kyu/ oṃ kṣ+raḥbadzra ḍā ma ru ka hum̐ phaṭa kyis bdun par cang te'u/ oṃ kṣ+raḥbadzra mutka ra hum̐ phaṭa kyis brgyad par tho ba/ oṃ kṣ+raḥbadzra tsakra hūm̐ phaṭa kyis dgu par 'khor lo/ oṃ kṣ+raḥbadzra kunda hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bcu par mdung*/ oṃ kṣ+raḥbadzra daṇḍa hum̐ phaṭa kyis bcu gcig par dbyug pa/ oṃ kṣ+raḥbadzra pa ra shu hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bcu gnyis par dgra st+wa bsnams pa/ de bzhin du oṃ hwām̐ badzra ghaṇḍe hoḥphreṃ phaṭa kyis g.yon gyi dang por dril bu/ oṃ hwām̐ badzra khe ṭa ka hoḥphreṃ phaṭa kyis gnyis par phub/ oṃ hwām̐ badzra kha ṭwāṃ ga hoḥphreṃ phaṭa kyis gsum par kha ṭwāṃ ga oṃ hwām̐ badzra ka pā la hoḥphreṃ phaṭa kyis bzhi par thod pa/

oṃ hwām̐ badzra tsā pa hoḥphreṃ phaṭa kyis lnga par gzhu/ oṃ hwām̐ badzra pā sha hoḥphreṃ phaṭa kyis drug par zhags pa/ oṃ hwām̐ badzra ratna hoḥphreṃ phaṭa kyis bdun par rin po che/ oṃ hwā badzra padma hoḥphreṃ phaṭa kyis brgyad par padma/ oṃ hwām̐ badzra sha kha hoḥphreṃ phaṭa kyis dgu par dung*/ oṃ hwām̐ badzrā darsha hoḥphreṃ phaṭa kyis bcu par me long*/ oṃ hwām̐ badzra shriṃ kha le hoḥphreṃ phaṭa kyis bcu gcig par lcags sgrog oṃ hwām̐ tsa turbe da mu kha swa bhā wa brahma shi ra hoḥphreṃ phaṭa kyis bcu gnyis par tshangs pa'i mgo bo bsnams pa phyag dang po gnyis kyis yum la 'khyud pa'o// yum sna tshogs yum sku mdog ser mo/ zhal bzhi spyan bcu gnyis phyag brgyad ma rtsa ba'i zhal ser ba/ g.yas dkar ba/ g.yon dmar ba/ rgyab gnag pa/ phyag g.yas pa rnams na/ gri gug dang*/ lcags kyu dang*/ ḍā ma ru dang*/ bgrang phreng 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa rnams na nya phyis dang*/ zhags pa dang*/ padma dkar po dang*/ lha'i rin po che bsnams pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i cod pan can/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa yab dang gnyis su med par bzhugs pa'o// de nas de'i zhar las byung ba'i lha dang mtshan ma bskyed pa ni/ shar du a las bdug spos as mtshan pa las byung ba ste/ 'og ma rnams la'ang de bzhin du sbyar la shes par bya'o// nag mo 'bar ma mo ni/ zhal bzhi phyag brgyad/ zhabs gnyis ma rtsa ba'i zhal gnag pa/ g.yas dmar/ g.yon dkar/ rgyab ser ba/ phyag g.yas pa rnams na/ bdug spos dang*/ tsandan dang*/ gur gum dang*/ gla rtsi dang*/ ga pur dang bcas pa'i snod rnams 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu dang*/ padma dang*/ lha'i shing gi me tog dang*/ me tog sna tshogs kyi phreng ba 'dzin pa'o// lhor aḥdang mar me las byung ba'i dmar mo 'bar ma zhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma/ rtsa ba'i zhal dmar ba/ g.yas ser/ g.yon sngo/ rgyab dkar ba/ phyag g.yas pa rnams na mar me dang*/ mu tig gi do shal dang*/

rin po che'i dbu rgyan dang*/ lag gdub 'dzin pa dang*/ g.yon pa rnams kyis lha'i gos dang*/ ska rags dang*/ rin po che'i rna rgyan dang*/ rkang gdub 'dzin pa'o// byang du am̐ dang lha bshos las dkar mo 'bar ma/ zhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma rtsa ba'i zhal dkar ba/ g.yas gnag g.yon ser/ rgyab dmar ba/ phyag g.yas pa rnams na 'o ma dang*/ chu gtsang dang*/ sman sna tshogs dang*/ chang gis gang ba'i snod rnams 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa rnams na bdud rtsi dang*/ bcud len gyi ro dang*/ 'bras bu dang*/ zas kyis gang ba'i snod rnams 'dzin pa'o// nub du ā dang dung las ser mo 'bar ma zhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma/ rtsa ba'i zhal ser ba/ g.yas dkar ba/ g.yon dmar ba/ rgyab gnag pa/ phyag g.yas pa rnams na dung dang*/ gling bu dang*/ nor bu dang*/ cang te'u 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa rnams ni pi wang dang*/ rnga dang*/ 'khar rnga dang*/ zangs dung 'dzin pa'o// rlung du hā dang rnga yab las mar me ma ser mo/ dbang ldan du ham̐ dang rnga yab las me khyor ma dkar mo/ srin por ha dang rnga yab las smig rgyu ma dmar mo/ mer ha dang*/ rnga yab las du ba ma nag po rnams phyag thams cad kyis rnga yab dkar po 'dzin pas bcom ldan 'das la g.yob pa/ lha mo thams cad mnyam pa'i zhabs kyis bzhugs pa'o// de nas mtshan ma dgod pa ni rdo rje phreng ba'i nang gi grwa bzhir dbang ldan du oṃ las byung ba'i dung dkar po/ srin por aḥlas byung ba'i ghaṇḍe dmar po/ mer hūm̐ las byung ba'i nor bu nag po/ rlung du hoḥlas byung ba'i dpag bsam gyis shing ser po dang*/ de'i phyi rol gyi 'phar ma'i de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ yum rnams kyi bar gyi ka ba'i bar dag tu/ shar du hi dang hī las rkang mar gyis yongs su gang ba'i bum pa nag po gnyis dang*/ lhor haṛ dang haṝ las byung ba'i khrag gis gang ba'i bum pa dmar po gnyis dang*/ byang du hūm̐ dang hūm̐ las byung ba'i dri chus gang ba'i bum pa dkar po gnyis dang*/

nub tu hl̥ dang hl̥̄ las byung ba'i dri chen gyis gang ba'i bum pa ser po gnyis te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phar ma'i bum pa brgyad dang*/ steng dang 'og tu ham̐ dang ha las thig le dang raktas yongs su gang ba'i rgyal ba dang rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa sngon po dang ljang gu bsgom par bya'o// de nas hūm̐ las shar sgo'i rta babs kyi steng du chos kyi 'khor lo g.yas skor du ri dwags pho mo dang bcas pa sngon po/ a las lhor bum pa dung dang padma dang bcas pa dmar po/ oṃ las byang du rnga bo che dbyug pa dang tho ba dang bcas pa dkar po/ nub tu ho las byang chub kyi shing gnod sbyin pho mo dang bcas pa ser po rnams bskyed cing dgod do// phyi rol gyi 'dod yon gyi snam bu'i shar gyi g.yas su/ tsatshadzadzhanya las byung ba'i dri ma dang*/ g.yon du/ tsatshadzadzhanyā las byung ba'i phreng ba ma gnyis nag mo/ lho'i g.yas su/ ṭaṭhaḍaḍhaṇa las bdug spos ma g.yon du/ ṭaṭhadadhaṇā las mar me ma gnyis dmar mo/ byang gyi g.yas su/ paphababham las bdud rtsi ma/ g.yon du/ paphababhamā las 'bras bu ma gnyis dkar mo/ nub kyi g.yas su/ tathadadhan las sgeg mo dang*/ g.yon du/ tathadadhan las bzhad ma gnyis ser mo/ shar sgo'i rta babs la kakhagaghang las rnga sgra ma pa ṭa ha 'dzin pa sngon mo/ nub tu/ kakhagaghangā las gar ma sngon mo/ byang du sanypaṣashaྈka las glu ma ljang gu/ lhor/ sanypaṣashaྈkā las 'dod ma ljang gu padma 'dzin pa thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma dkyil 'khor gyi lha la mchod pa rnams bskyed cing dgod do// 'byung ba lnga'i khor yug dang rta babs kyi rgyan 'di dag sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol dang*/ rta babs la dgod par bshad mod/ 'dir thugs kyi dkyil 'khor rkyang pa bsgom pa'i phyir mtshan nyid de dag rdzogs par sbyar na mdzes par mthong ngo*// nus ldan ma rnams dang*/ 'dod yon gyi lha mo rnams ni mgron thabs kyi tshul du bskyed pa'i phyir thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi grangs su mi bgrang ngo*// de dag ni rgyu'i rdo rje sems dpa' bskyed pa'o// de nas 'khor gyi lha rnams bskyed pa'i phyir yab kyi gsang gnas hūm̐ las rdo rje nag po padmas mtshan pa yum gyi mkha' āḥlas padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa rdo rjes mtshan pa bskyed nas snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba chen po'i sgras/

phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang rig ma dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ sems ma dang*/ khro bo dang*/ khro mo'i tshogs thams cad spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ yab kyi phung po dang*/ khams dang*/ blo'i dbang po dang*/ yul dang*/ las kyi dbang po dang*/ yul rnams la zhugs/ de thams cad rigs lnga dang*/ yum lnga dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ sems ma dang*/ khro bo dang*/ khro mo rnams su gyur/ de nas yab la rjes su zhugs pa'i lha de rnams rdo rje'i lam nas 'phros nas yum gyi phung po la sogs la thim pas/ de dag kyang lha so sor gyur nas yum la rjes su zhugs pa'i lha rnams slar yang yab kyi zhal du zhugs nas/ thugs kar zhu ba rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa sa bon gyi yi ge nyi shu rtsa lnga las phyag mtshan sa bon gyis mtshan par gyur cing*/ de las byung ba'i lha nyi shu rtsa lngar bltas la re re zhing spros nas dkyil 'khor la dgod par bya ste/ a dang rdo rje las mi bskyod pa ljang gu zhal gsum gyi g.yas dmar g.yon dkar/ phyag g.yas gsum na rdo rje/ gri gug dgra st+wa 'dzin zhing*/ g.yon gsum na dril bu/ thod pa/ tshangs pa'i mgo bo 'dzin pa/ yum aḥdang gri gug las byung ba'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma sngon mo g.yon dmar zhing g.yas dkar ba/ phyag g.yas gsum na gri gug rdo rje/ dgra st+wa/ g.yon gsum na thod pa/ dril bu/ tshangs pa'i mgo bo rnams 'dzin pa dang*/ sbyor ba spros nas mi bskyod pa rang gi thugs ka dang*/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma yum gyi thugs kar thim par bsam/ de nas i dang ral gri las don yod grub pa nag po zhal g.yas dmar/ g.yon dkar ba/ phyag g.yas gsum na ral gri/ gri gug rtse gsum/ g.yon gsum na/ phub/ thod pa/ kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin zhing*/ spyan ma dang sbyor ba spros la shar du dgod do// ṛ dang rin po che las rin chen 'byung ldan dmar po/ zhal g.yas dkar/ g.yon gnag pa/

phyag g.yas gsum na me'i mda'/ rdo rje lcags kyu/ sgra dang bcas pa'i cang te'u/ g.yon gsum na gzhu dang*/ zhags pa/ 'od zer dang bcas pa'i nor bu 'dzin zhing mā ma kī dang sbyor ba spros la lhor dgod do// u dang padma las 'od dpag med dkar po/ zhal g.yas gnag g.yon dmar ba/ phyag g.yas gsum na tho ba/ mdung thung*/ rtse gsum/ g.yon gsum na 'dab ma brgyad dang ldan pa'i padma dkar po dang*/ me long*/ phreng ba 'dzin zhing gos dkar mo dang sbyor ba spros nas byang du dgod do// l̥ dang 'khor lo las rnam par snang mdzad ser po/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon gnag pa/ phyag g.yas gsum na 'khor lo/ dbyug pa/ rdo rje gdengs pa/ g.yon gsum na dung*/ lcags sgrog sgra dang bcas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ sgrol ma dang sbyor ba spros nas nub tu dgod do// l̥̄ dang 'khor lo las byung ba'i spyan ma rnam par snang mdzad lta bu don yod grub pa dang sbyor ba spros nas rlung du dgod do// ū dang padma las mā ma kī 'od dpag med dang mtshungs shing rin chen 'byung ldan dang sbyor ba spros nas dbang ldan du dgod do// ṝ dang rin po che las gos dkar mo rin chen 'byung ldan dang mtshungs shing 'od dpag med dang sbyor ba spros nas bden bral du dgod do// ī dang ral gri las sgrol ma/ g.yon gyi gsum par utpal 'dzin pa/ gzhan don yod grub pa dang mtshungs shing*/ rnam par snang mdzad dang sbyor ba spros nas mer dgod do// de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phar ma'o// de nas de'i phyi rol gyi 'phar ma la a dang rdo rje las phyag na rdo rje ljang gu mi bskyod pa dang mtshungs shing sgra rdo rje ma dang sbyor ba spros pa lho sgo'i g.yon du dgod do// e dang ral gri las nam mkha'i snying po don yod grub pa dang mtshungs shing dri rdo rje dang sbyor ba spros la shar sgo'i g.yas su dgod do// ar dang rin po che las sa'i snying po rin chen 'byung ldan dang mtshungs shing gzugs rdo rje dang sbyor ba spros la lho sgo'i g.yas su dgod do// o dang padma las 'jig rten dbang phyug 'od dpag med dang mtshungs shing ro rdo rje dang sbyor ba spros la byang sgo'i g.yas su dgod do// al dang 'khor lo las sgrib pa rnam par sel ba rnam par snang mdzad dang mtshungs shing reg rdo rje dang sbyor ba spros la nub sgo'i g.yas su dgod do// am̐ dang rdo rje las kun tu bzang po sngon po/

zhal g.yas dmar la/ g.yon dkar ba/ phyag g.yas gsum na gri gug rdo rje/ dgra st+wa dang*/ g.yon gsum na thod pa/ dril bu/ utpal 'dzin pa/ chos kyi dbyings rdo rje ma dang sbyor ba spros la shar sgo'i g.yon du dgod do// aḥdang rdo rje las sgra rdo rje ma sngon mo/ zhal g.yas dmar la/ g.yon dkar ba/ phyag g.yas gsum na gri gug rdo rje/ dgra st+wa g.yon gsum na thod pa/ gri gug tshangs pa'i mgo bo 'dzin pa/ phyag na rdo rje dang sbyor ba spros la byang sgo'i g.yon du dgod do// āl dang 'khor lo las dri rdo rje ma spyan ma dang mtshungs shing nam mkha'i snying po dang sbyor ba spros la rlung du dgod do// au dang padma las gzugs rdo rje mā ma kī dang mtshungs shing sa'i snying po dang sbyor ba spros la dbang ldan du dgod do// ār dang rin po che las ro rdo rje ma gos dkar mo dang mtshungs shing 'jig rten dbang phyug dang sbyor ba spros la bden bral du dgod do// ai dang ral gri las reg rdo rje ma sgrol ma dang mtshungs shing sgrib pa rnam sel dang sbyor ba spros la mer dgod do// ā dang rdo rje las chos kyi dbyings kyi rdo rje ma ljang gu phyag mtshan mi bskyod pa dang mtshungs shing kun tu bzang po dang sbyor ba spros la nub sgo'i g.yon du dgod do// sems dpa'i 'phar ma'o// de'i phyi rol yam̐ dang ral gri las khro bo bgegs mthar byed don yod grub pa dang mtshungs shing yum rengs byed ma ser mo zhal bzhi phyag bzhi ma/ phyag g.yas pa gnyis na 'khor lo dang dbyug pa/ g.yon gnyis na dung dang rin po che 'dzin pa dang sbyor ba spros la shar sgor dgod do// ram̐ dang dbyug pa las shes rab mthar byed rin chen 'byung ldan dang mtshungs shing yum nga rgyal can ma dkar mo/ phyag g.yas pa gnyis na tho ba dang dung*/ g.yon gnyis na padma dang me long 'dzin pa dang sbyor ba spros la lho sgor dgod do// wam̐ dang padma las padma mthar byed 'od dpag med dang mtshungs shing yum rmongs byed ma dmar mo/

phyag g.yas na mda' dang lcags kyu/ g.yon na gzhu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa dang sbyor ba spros la byang sgor dgod do// lam̐ dang tho ba las gshin rje gshed rnam par snang mdzad dang mtshungs shing*/ yum brtson 'grus can ma nag mo/ g.yas na ral gri dang rdo rje/ g.yon na phub dang sbrul 'dzin pa dang sbyor ba spros la nub sgor dgod do// de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ni padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la rdo rje'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs shing*/ yum rnams padma dang zla ba'i gdan la padma'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs la/ sems dpa' rnams ni de bzhin gshegs pa dang mtshungs te/ 'on kyang rin po che'i rgyan can no// sems ma rnams ni yum dang mtshungs la/ de dag gi rgyan yang rin po che las grub pa'o// de rnams kyi yab gtso bor gyur pa'i gnas su yum gyis pang nas 'khyud cing*/ yum gtso bor gyur pa'i gnas su yab kyis pang nas 'khyud pa yin no// khro bo rnams ni rab tu khros pa/ padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la bzhengs te g.yas brkyang pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de dag gi yum khro mo rnams ni zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yon brkyang bas bzhugs shing*/ gnyis ka'ang dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa stag dang sbrul gyis brgyan par bsam mo// de nas oṃ su bi shuddha dharm+ma dhā tu dzñā na swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod cing don dran par byas pas byin gyis brlab bo// de nas snying rje'i dbang bskur ba'i phyir/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad la phog sems can rnams gzhal yas khang pa'i sgo bzhi nas bkug pa bdag gi gtsug tor nas zhugs/ thugs kar ye shes kyi mes bzhus/ rdo rje'i lam nas byang chub kyi sems kyi thig le'i rnam pas yum gyi mkhar babs pa rnams lha'i skur gyur nas sbyor mtshams nas spros pa rnams dkyil 'khor gyi nang gi khor yug tu 'khod par bsgom mo// de nas rang gi thugs ka nas spros pa'i 'od zer gyis sngar bskyed pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams bkug nas thugs kar zhugs shing*/

zhu ba'i byang chub kyi sems rdo rje'i lam nas spros pas sems can thams cad kyi spyi gtsug nas dbang bskur bas sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad sbyangs shing*/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas/ zhal gsum pa dang*/ zhal sna tshogs pa dang*/ kha dog sna tshogs pa'i lhar gyur zhing de dag re re yang*/ phung po lnga/ kṣa kṣi kṣ+r-i kṣu kṣl̥ las de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ khams lnga/ kṣā kṣī kṣṝ kṣū kṣl̥̄ las yum dang*/ dbang po drug kṣa kṣe kṣar kṣo kṣal kṣaṃ las byang chub sems pa dang*/ yul drug kṣā kṣai kṣār kṣau kṣāl kṣaṃ las sems ma dang*/ las kyi dbang po lnga/ kṣaha kṣaya kṣ+ra kṣawa kṣ+la las khro bo dang*/ las kyi dbang po'i yul lnga/ kṣahā kṣayā kṣ+rā kṣawā kṣ+lā las khro mo rnams su gyur par dmigs nas de dag la yid las byung ba'i mchod pas mchod de gang nas 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing du gshegs par bsam mo// de nas yab yum gnyis ka'i lte ba dang*/ gtsug tor du hoḥ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐/ bkod cing rdo rje dang padma sngar bzhin byin gyis brlabs nas snyoms par zhugs pas/ rjes su chags pa'i mes yab yum gnyi ga 'od du zhu nas bde ba chen po'i ngo bo thig le'i bdag nyid du gnas pa las/ thig le bzhi mtshams bzhir 'phros pas yum bzhir gyur nas/ rim pa bzhin glus bskul ba ni/ spyan ma bdag ni 'gro ba'i yum// rgyu mthun rnal 'byor la gnas pa// bdag ni dkyil 'khor rang bzhin pas// dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag 'dod mdzod// mā ma kī bdag sring mo ste// rnam smin rnal 'byor la gnas pa// bdag ni dkyil 'khor rang bzhin pas// dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag 'dod mdzod// gos dkar mo bdag bu mo ste// skyes bu'i rnal 'byor la gnas pa// bdag ni dkyil 'khor rang bzhin pas// dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag 'dod mdzod// sgrol ma bdag ni tsha mo ste// bral ba'i rnal 'byor la gnas pa// bdag ni dkyil 'khor rang bzhin pas// dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag 'dod mdzod// stong pa'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas// 'gro ba bsgral ba'i thugs dgongs kyis// sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor rnams// 'gro ba'i mgon pos spro bar mdzod// ces rim pa bzhin glus bskul nas// lha mo rnams skar mda'i tshul gyis thig le la thim pa dang*/

thig le hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur pa las bzhengs pa'i 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa dus kyi 'khor lo gsal gdab par bya'o// de'ang rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa dang 'dra ste/ 'on kyang mi bskyod pa'i rgyas gdab cing*/ stag gi pags pa dang klu brgyad kyi rgyas gdab spangs la/ phyag rgya dang phyag mtshan gyi rgyas gdab/ gzhan rnams ni snga ma ltar sngags dang bcas pa'i rgyas gdab bo// de nas nang gi rgyas gdab pa'i phyir/ bdag nyid kyis gtsug tor gyi dkyil 'khor du/ thig le'i steng du a las mi bskyod pa ljang gu/ snying gar sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor la i las don yod grub pa nag po/ dpral bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la u las 'od dpag med dkar po/ lte bar dus me'i dkyil 'khor la l̥ las rnam par snang mdzad ser po/ mgrin par nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la ṛ las rin chen 'byung ldan dmar po/ gsang gnas su ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor la am̐ las rdo rje sems dpa' sngon po rnams dgod pa ni sku'i rgyas gdab pa'o// lte bar sa'i dkyil 'khor la l̥̄/ snying gar chu'i dkyil 'khor la ū/ mgrin par me'i dkyil 'khor la ṝ/ dpral bar rlung gi dkyil 'khor la ī/ gtsug tor du nam mkha' la ā'i yig 'bru rnams dgod pa ni gsung gi rgyas gdab pa'o// de nas dpral bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la oṃ/ mgrin par nyi ma la āḥsnying gar sgra gcan la hum̐/ lte bar dus me la hoḥ dgod pa ni sems kyi rgyas gdab pa'o// rdo rje nor bu'i nang du ā li'i yi ge dgod pa ni ye shes kyi rgyas gdab pa'o// de nas yab kyi thugs kar padma dmar po dang*/ zla ba'i steng du a dang rdo rje las mi bskyod pa ljang gu/ a dang gri gug las byung ba'i yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma sngon mo dang sbyor ba dang*/ yum gyi thugs kar padma dkar po dang nyi ma'i steng du/ a dang gri gug las rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma ljang gu/

pang na a dang rdo rje las byung ba'i rdo rje sems dpa' sngon po dang sbyor ba bsgoms nas/ oṃ su bi shuddha dharma dhā tu dzñā na swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod do// de nas snga ma ltar yab yum gyi mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs te snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba'i sgras rang bzhin gyis bzhugs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang mtshan ma thams cad spyan drangs pa la mchod pa rnams kyis mchod nas/ yab kyi gtsug tor nas zhugs/ thugs kar zhu/ rdo rje'i lam nas byang chub kyi sems kyi thig le'i rnam pas yum gyi mkhar bab pa yan lag gsum dang*/ sa bon las lha dang mtshan ma'i tshogs yongs su rdzogs par bskyed nas/ rim pa bzhin spros la dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang*/ mtshan ma'i gnas rnams su dgod par bya'o// dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin no// de nas rang gi snying gar padma'i lte ba la zla ba dang nyi ma dang sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor brtsegs pa'i steng du hum̐ las rdo rje rtse mo lnga pa/ lte ba la dzaḥs mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las lcags kyur gyur cing de'ang yongs su gyur pa las shar du dzaḥlas drangs pa'i shing rta la gnas pa'i rdo rje shugs phyag nyi shu rtsa drug pa 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa dang 'dra bar 'phros bzhin pa glog 'gyu ba dang 'dra bar spros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor dang mtshungs pa'i ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs nas/ rdo rje shugs rang gi snying gar bsdu bar bya'o// de nas rang gi snying ga nas hūm̐ las mchod pa'i lha mo bcu gnyis spros pas mchod cing bstod nas snying ga'i hūm̐ las hūm̐ 'phros shing*/ de las rdo rje de yongs su gyur pa las shes rab mthar byed rdo rje 'dzin pa spros pas ye shes pa rnams dam tshig pa la gzhug par bya'o// de bzhin du bam̐ las zhags par gyur pa las gshin rje gshed tho ba 'dzin pa spros pas ye shes pa rnams dam tshig pa rnams la gnyis su med par bcings nas brtan par bya'o// yang hoḥlas dril bu de yongs su gyur pa las padma mthar byed padma 'dzin pa spros pas ye shes pa rnams dam tshig pa la dgyes par bya'o// hri las byug pa de yongs su gyur pa las bgegs mthar byed dbyug pa 'dzin pa spros pas ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa ro mnyam par byas par bsgoms nas/

so so'i sa bon gyi sngags rim pa bzhin brjod par bya'o// de ltar ye shes pa ro gcig par gyur pa dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad thabs dang shes rab phan tshun ro mnyam par bsgoms pa'i rgyas gdab par bya ste/ lha yab yum mnyam par sbyor ba rnams ni rnam shes dang*/ ye shes dang*/ rlung dang*/ sa dang*/ me dang*/ chu phan tshun sbyor ba yin pas de'i don dran par bya'o// de nas dpral bar āḥlas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan par gyur pa las sku rdo rje dkar po/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ zhal g.yas gnag pa/ g.yon dmar ba/ phyag g.yas gsum na 'khor lo/ padma/ rdo rje/ g.yon gsum na ral gri/ dril bu/ nor bu 'dzin cing yum dang sbyor ba bsgoms nas phyir 'phros pas dpag tu med par gyur nas skus 'dul ba'i sems can thams cad kyi don mdzad cing chos bstan nas slar 'dus te rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar byon pa la/ sku rdo rje 'dzin pas bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas sku rdo rje'i thugs ka nas sku'i lha mo du ma 'phros pas bdud rtsi'i bum pas spyi bo nas dbang bskur bar bsam mo// denas/ dpal ldan sku yi rdo rje 'chang*// bdag ni byin rlabs gnas yin pas// mi phyed rdo rje gsum thob par// myur bar sku yi rdo rjer mdzod// phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams// bdag byin brlab pa'i gnas yin pas// mi phyed rdo rje gsum thob par// myur bar sku yi rdo rjer mdzod// ces gsol ba btab pas/ sku rdo rje dpral bar zla ba la zhugs shing lha mo rnams gtsug tor du thim par bsam mo// de nas mgrin par ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du āḥlas padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa yongs su gyur pa las gsung rdo rje dmar po zhal g.yas dkar ba/ g.yon gnag pa/ phyag g.yas gsum na/ padma/ rdo rje/ 'khor lo/

g.yon gsum na/ nor bu/ dril bu/ ral gri 'dzin pa yum dang sbyor ba bsgoms nas/ phyir 'phros pas dpag tu med par gyur nas/ gsung gis 'dul ba'i sems can thams cad kyi don mdzad cing chos bstan nas slar 'dus te rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar byon pa la gsung rdo rje 'dzin pas bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ gsung rdo rje'i thugs ka nas gsung gi lha mo du ma 'phros pas bdud rtsi'i bum pas spyi bo nas dbang bskur bar bsam mo// de nas/ dpal ldan gsung gi rdo rje 'chang*// bdag ni byin rlabs gnas yin pas// mi phyed rdo rje gsum thob par// myur bar gsung gi rdo rjer mdzod// phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams// bdag ni byin rlabs gnas yin pas// mi phyed rdo rje gsum thob par// myur bar gsung gi rdo rjer mdzod// ces gsol ba btab pas/ gsung rdo rje mgrin par nyi ma la bzhugs shing*/ lha mo rnams gtsug tor du thim par bsam mo// de nas snying gar aṃ las sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hum̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa yongs su gyur pa las/ thugs rdo rje nag po/ zhal g.yas dmar/ g.yon dkar ba/ phyag g.yas gsum na rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ padma/ g.yon gsum na/ dril bu ral gri/ nor bu 'dzin zhing yum dang sbyor ba bsgoms nas phyir 'phros pas/ dpag tu med par gyur nas thugs kyis 'dul ba'i sems can thams cad kyi don mdzad cing chos bstan nas slar 'dus te/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar byon pa la/ thugs rdo rje 'dzin pas bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ thugs rdo rje'i thugs ka nas thugs kyi lha mo du ma 'phros pas bdud rtsi'i bum pas spyi bo nas dbang bskur bar bsam mo// de nas/ dpal ldan thugs kyi rdo rje 'chang*// bdag ni byin rlabs gnas yin pas// mi phyed rdo rje gsum thob par// myur bar thugs kyi rdo rjer mdzod// phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams// bdag ni byin rlabs gnas yin pas// mi phyed rdo rje gsum thob par// myur bar thugs kyi rdo rjer mdzod// ces gsol ba btab pas/

thugs rdo rje snying gar sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bzhugs shing*/ lha mo rnams gtsug tor du thim par bsam mo// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāktsitta badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod cing don dran par bya'o// sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs pa de dag gtso bo la gtso bor bya zhing*/ 'khor rnams la zhar byung gi tshul gyis bsgom par bya'o// khyad par du yum rnams la ni lte bar hoḥlas sku dang*/ gsang bar swa las gsung dang*/ spyi gtsug tu haḥlas thugs byin gyis brlab par bya'o// gzhan rnams ni 'dra'o// de nas dbang gi rtags rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyas gdab par bya ste/ gtso bo'i spyi bor mi bskyod pa/ yum la rdo rje sems dpa' gnyis ka'ang dbu'i gtsug tor dang ldan zhing chos gos mnabs pa/ phyag g.yas pa sa gnon gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o// yab yum gyi thugs ka'i mi bskyod pa la rdo rje sems dpa'/ rdo rje sems dpa' la mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan zhing*/ don yod grub pa la rin chen 'byung ldan/ 'od dpag du med pa la rnam par snang mdzad/ rin chen 'byung ldan la 'od dpag med/ rnam par snang mdzad la mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par bsam mo// rigs drug pa de dag ni ral pa'i cod pan can no// lha gzhan rnams la shar dang shar lho'i la don yod grub pa/ lho dang lho nub kyi la rin chen 'byung ldan/ byang dang byang shar gyi la 'od dpag med/ nub dang nub byang gi la rnam par snang mdzad/ kun tu bzang po dang sgra rdo rje la rdo rje sems dpa'/ phyag na rdo rje dang chos kyi dbyings kyi rdo rje ma la mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par bsam mo// de nas gong du bstan pa ltar rang gi snying ga nas sa bon so so las bskyed pa'i lha mo bcu gnyis rim pa bzhin spros nas/ so so'i sngags dang phyag rgyas bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo la mchod par bya'o// de nas bdud rtsi'i ri lu'am/

yang na de dang sbyar ba'i chang gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs nas gong du spros pa'i lha mo de dag gis/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi zhal du rim pa bzhin bstabs pa myang zhing mid pas lus thams cad bdud rtsis gang zhing mchod par bsams nas/ dngos su yang bdud rtsi myang zhing*/ lha so so'i mtshan sngags kyang brjod par bya'o/ de nas lha mo de dag gis bstod par bsam zhing*/ mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud// yang dag mthar gyur khyod la 'dud// stong nyid las byung khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas byang chub khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas chags pa khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas 'dod la phyag 'tshal 'dud// sangs rgyas dgyes pa khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas rol la phyag 'tshal 'dud// sangs rgyas 'dzum pa khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas bzhad la phyag 'tshal 'dud// sangs rgyas gsung nyid khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas thugs la phyag 'tshal 'dud// med pa las byung khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas 'byung ba khyod la 'dud// nam mkha' las byung khyod la 'dud// ye shes las byung khyod la 'dud// sgyu 'phrul drwa ba khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas rol ston khyod la 'dud// thams cad thams cad khyod la 'dud// ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud// ces brjod nas mchod pa'i lha mo de dag thugs kar bsdus la rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo snang la rang bzhin med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bu la sems gtad nas mnyam par gzhag par bya'o// bskyed pa'i rim pa'o// de nas rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa ni lus kyi 'khrul 'khor dang ldan pas/ lus kyi dbus kyi cha la rtsa dbu ma phra zhing drang la gsal ba la brten pa'i lte ba'i thad kar ho dmar po/ snying ga'i 'khor lo lte ba dang bcas pa la/ a i/ ri u/ l̥ l̥̄/ ū ṝ/ ī a rnams dang ldan pa/ mgrin pa'i 'khor lo 'dab ma brgyad pa lte ba dang bcas pa la/

a e ar o al/ āl au ār ai ā rnams dang ldan pa/ dpral ba'i 'khor lo 'dab ma brgyad pa lte ba dang bcas pa la ha ya ra wa la/ lā wā rā yā hā rnams dang ldan pa/ gtsug tor du ham̐ dkar po mgo thur du lta ba bsams la/ steng 'og gi rlung kha sbyor ba'i nus pas lte ba'i ho las gtum mo'i me 'bar ba dbu ma'i nang na yar song bas snying ga'i 'khor lo'i yi ge rnams bsregs/ de nas rim pa bzhin du mgrin pa dang dpral ba'i 'khor lo'i yi ge rnams bsregs nas ham̐ la bsnun pas/ ham̐ las byangachub kyi sems bdud rtsi'i rgyun dkar po dbu ma'i lam nas babs pas/ dpral ba dang*/ mgrin pa dang*/ snying ga'i 'khor lo'i yi ge rnams rim pa bzhin sngar bas kyang gsal bar byas nas ho la phog pas me'i nus pa cher 'phel bas gyen du song*/ des ham̐ gi bdud rtsi'i rgyun bskul nas thur du 'bab pa'i dbang gis drod dang*/ bde ba dang ye shes skye bar bsam zhing bum pa can gyi rlung gzung bar bya'o// gtum mo'i rnal 'byor ro// de nas thig le dang phra mo'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa ni/ bdag nyid gtso bo yab yum du gsal bar dmigs nas/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ/ snying gar hūm̐/ gsang bar swa/ gtsug tor du haḥrnams bkod nas yum gyi mkha' mi dmigs te/ stong pa'i ngang las a las padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rjes mtshan pa dang*/ yab kyi gsang ba mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse mo lnga pa/ lte bar a las byung ba'i padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pas mtshan par bsgoms nas/ snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba'i sgras khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad nye bar bkug pa gtsug tor nas zhugs nas 'khor lo drug na gnas pa'i byang chub kyi sems rnams dang ro gcig tu 'dres nas rim pa bzhin babs par bsams nas hūm̐ zhes brjod do// de nas phaṭa ces brjod pas rdo rje nor bu'i nang du gnas par bsam mo// slar yang hūm̐ zhes brjod pas yum gyi rakta rdo rje'i sbu gu nas drangs nas phaṭa ces brjod pas thig le la thim pas/

sems can thams cad kyi phung po lnga de bzhin gshegs pa lnga dang*/ khams lnga yum lnga dang*/ dbang po drug sems dpa' drug dang*/ yul drug sems ma drug dang*/ las kyi dbang po lnga khro bo lnga dang*/ las kyi dbang po'i lus lnga khro mo lngar gyur nas/ slar yang hūm̐ zhes brjod cing snyoms par zhugs pas/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs pa gtsug tor nas zhugs/ thig le'i rnam pas rim pa bzhin babs nas phaṭa ces brjod pas rdo rje'i sbu gu'i thig le la thim zhing sems can rnams la dbang bskur nas/ 'dres te 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa ro gcig pa bde ba dang stong pa zung du 'jug pa'i bdag nyid du bltas la/ bde ba chen pos de bzhin gshegs pa rnams mchod par bsam zhing*/ oṃ dzñā na pū dza a nu rā ga ṇa badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod nas bde ba bsgom mo// de nas hūm̐ zhes brjod cing byang chub kyi sems kyi thig le dbu ma'i lam nas gyen du drangs pas/ rgyu mthun pa la sogs pa'i ngo bo lte ba la sogs pa'i gnas su dga' ba la sogs pa'i ye shes mngon du byas nas dbu ma'i sna gtsug tor gyi rtse mor ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin 'od zer lnga dang ldan pa'i thig le'i gzugs su gnas par bsgoms la sems bzung ngo*// de nas yid 'phro na thig le las/ khams gsum gyi sems can sangs rgyas su gyur pa rnams spros la gang nas 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing du gshegs par bsam mo// khyim pa rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rigs spel bar 'dod pas ni/ thig le yum gyi bha gar phab la sbyor mtshams nas spro bar bya'o// tshul 'di ni rten thig le 'bebs pa dang bzlog pa'i phyir thig le'i rnal 'byor yin la/ de la brten pa ye shes phra zhing rtogs par dka' ba skye ba'i phyir phra mo'i rnal 'byor zhes brjod do// thig le dang phra mo'i rnal 'byor ro// sbyor ba yan lag drug bsgom pa'i tshul ni gzhan du shes par bya'o// rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o// de nas bzlas pa ni lha so so'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi yi ge'i mthar sngags kyi phreng ba bkod pa la dmigs nas/

oṃ ham̐kṣamalawaraya swā hā zhes pa dang*/ oṃ āḥhum̐ hoḥham̐ kṣaḥswā hā zhes pa dang*/ oṃ hrām̐ hrīṃ hraṝṃ hrūm̐ hṛṃlā hraḥswā hā/ zhes bya ba gtso bo'i sngags rnams dang*/ oṃ bi shwa mā tā swā hā zhes pa yum gyi dang*/ oṃ a kṣo bhya ya swā hā/ oṃ badzra sa twa ya swā hā/ oṃ a mo gha siddhā ya swā hā/ oṃ ratna saṃ bha wā ya swā hā/ oṃ a mi tā bhā ya swā hā/ oṃ bai ro tsa nā ya swā hā/ oṃ lo tsa nā ya swā hā/ oṃ mā ma kyai swā hā/ oṃ pāṇḍa rī ye swā hā/ oṃ tā rā yai swā hā/ oṃ badzra pā ṇā ya swā hā/ oṃ kha garbhā ya swā hā/ oṃ kṣi ti garbhā ya swā hā/ oṃ lo ke shwa rā ya swā hā/ oṃ sarba ni ba ra ṇa biskambi nā ya swā hā/ oṃ sa manta bha brā ya swā hā/ oṃ gandha badzrā yai swā hā/ oṃ rū pa badzrā yai swā hā/ oṃ ra sa badzrā yai swā hā/ oṃ sparṣa badzrā yai swā hā/ oṃ dharm+ma dhā tu badzrā yai swā hā/ oṃ shabda badzrā yai swā hā/ oṃ bi ghān ta kā ya swā hā/ oṃ pra dzñānta kā ya swā hā/ oṃ padmanta kā ya swā hā/ oṃ ya mānta kā ya swā hā/ zhes pa rnams ci nus pas bzlas so// de nas gtor ma gcig la sogs pa ji ltar 'byor pa bshams la/ bgegs mthar byed kyi sngags kyis bsangs nas/ lag pa g.yon pa zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du bsams pas bkab la rnam par dag par bsams nas// oṃ oṃ badzra tsand+ra sarba dharmā bi shuddha swa bhā wa sarba dharmā bi sho dha ya swā hā/ zhes brjod do// de nas lag pa g.yas pa nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du bsams pas bkab la/ bsam gyis mi khyab par spel bar bsgoms la/ oṃ āḥbadzra sūrya sarba dharmā pra bo dha ka sarba dharmā na pra bo dha ya swā hā zhes brjod do// de nas lag pa gnyis ka las ye shes kyi me byung bas sbar bar bsams nas gnyis kas bkab la/ oṃ hum̐ḥbadzra ā na la sarba dharmā pra dī pa ka sarba dharmā na pra dī pā ya swā hā/

zhes brjod do// de nas bya khyung gi phyag rgya bcas pa las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa/ zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsams la/ oṃ hoḥsarba dharmā badzrā mṛ ta ka ra sarba dharmā na a mṛ taṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod pas byin gyis brlab bo// de nas rdo rje kha phye la dus kyi 'khor lo'i thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams spyan drangs pa la phul bar bsams la/ oṃ āḥhum̐ hoḥshrī kā la tsakra bhyaḥs pa ri wā re bhyaḥ i daṃ/ ba liṃ/ gandhaṃ/ puṣpaṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ akṣa taṃ/ da dā ma he/ te tsā gā tya/ sa pa ri wā rāḥshī ghraṃ/ i daṃ/ ba liṃ/ gṛhṇantu/ khā dantu/ pi pantu/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa tṛptāḥ sarba sa twā nāṃ/ shīntaṃ/ puṣṭiṃ/ rakṣa a wa ra ṇa/ guptiṃ/ kurban tu hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā zhes pas dbul lo// de nas rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ khro bo'i rgyal po bcu spyan drangs pa la mchod par bsam zhing*/ oṃ āḥhum̐ hoḥ uṣṇī ṣa/ sumbha ni sumbha/ bighānta ka nī la daṇḍa/ pra dzñānta ka ṭakki rā dzā/ padmānta ka a tsa la ya mānta ka ma hā bā la bhyaḥ sa pa ri wā re bhyaḥ i daṃ ba liṃ/ gandhaṃ/ puṣpaṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ a kṣa taṃ/ da dā ma he/ te tsā gā tya/ sa pa ri wā rāḥ shī ghraṃ/ i daṃ/ ba liṃ/ grihṇantu/ khā dantu/ pi pantu/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ saṃ tṛptaḥ sarba sa twā nāṃ/ shāntiṃ/ puṣṭiṃ/ rakṣa a wa ra ṇa/ guptiṃ/ kurbantu/ hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ badzra dha ra ā dzñā pa ya ti swā hā/ zhes pas dbul lo// de nas gri gug gi phyag rgya bcas la/ zad par gyi lha rnams spyan drangs pa la dbul bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ āḥhum̐ hoḥ ā kā sha bā yu te dza/ u da ka pṛ thwī sā dha te bhyaḥ sa pa ri wā re bhyaḥ i daṃ/ ba liṃ/ gandhaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ a kṣa taṃ/ da dā ma he/ te tsā gā tya/ sa pa ri wā rāḥ shī ghraṃ/ i daṃ/ ba liṃ/

gṛhṇantā/ khā dantu/ pi pantu/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ sam̐ tṛptaḥ sarba satwā nāṃ/ shāntiṃ/ puṣṭiṃ/ rakṣa a wa ra ṇa/ guptiṃ/ kurbantu/ hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ badzra dha ra ā dzñā pa ya ti swā hā/ zhes pas dbul lo// de nas ral gri'i phyag rgya bcas la/ phyogs skyong ba'i lha chen po rnams spyan drangs pa la dbul bar bsam zhing oṃ āḥhum̐ hoḥ brahma/ biṣṇu/ nir ṛ tya/ bā yu/ ya ma/ agni/ sa mu dre/ shwa ra/ ind+ra yakṣe bhyaḥ sa pa ri wa re bhyaḥ i daṃ/ ba liṃ/ gandhaṃ/ puṣpaṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ akṣa taṃ/ da dā ma he/ te tsā gā tya/ sa pa ri wā rāḥ shī ghaṃ/ i daṃ/ ba liṃ/ gṛhṇantu/ khā dantu/ pi pantu/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ saṃ triptāḥ sarba sa twā nāṃ/ shāntiṃ/ puṣṭiṃ/ rakṣa a wa ra ṇa/ guptiṃ/ kurbantu/ hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ badzra dha ra ā dzñā pa ya ti swā hā/ zhes pas dbul lo// de nas rin po che'i phyag rgya bcas la/ gza' rnams spyan drangs pa la dbul bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ āḥhum̐ hoḥrā hu kā la agni/ tsand+ra/ sūrya/ budha/ maṃ ga la/ shu kra/ bṛ haspa ti/ ke tu sha ni shu re bhyaḥ sa pa ri wā re bhāḥ i daṃ/ ba liṃ/ gandhaṃ/ puṣpaṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ akṣa taṃ/ da dā ma he/ te tsā gā tya/ sa pa ri wā rāḥ shī ghraṃ/ i daṃ/ ba liṃ/ gṛhṇantu/ khā dantā/ pi bantu dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ saṃ tṛptāḥ sarba sa twā nāṃ/ shāntiṃ/ pīṣṭaṃ/ rakṣa a wa ra ṇa/ guptiṃ/ kurbantu/ hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ badzra dha ra ā dzñā pa ya ti swā hā/ zhes pas dbul lo// de nas padma'i phyag rgya bcas la/ klu chen po rnams spyan drangs pa la dbul bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ āḥhum̐ hoḥ dza ya/ bi dza ya/ padma/ karko ṭa/ bā su ki shaṃ kha pā la/ ku li ka a nanta/ takṣa ka ma hā padme bhyaḥ sa pa ri wā re bhāḥ i daṃ/ ba liṃ/ gandhaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ akṣa taṃ/ da dā ma he/ te tsā gā tya/ sa pa ri wā rāḥ shī ghraṃ/ i daṃ/ ba liṃ/ gṛhṇantu/ khā dantu/ pi bantu dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ saṃ tṛptāḥ sarba sa twā nāṃ/

shāntiṃ/ puṣṭiṃ/ rakṣa a wa ra ṇa/ guptiṃ/ kurbantu/ hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ badzra dha ra ā dzñā pa ya ti swā hā/ zhes pas dbul lo// de nas 'khor lo'i phyag rgya bcas la/ 'byung po chen po rnams spyan drangs pa la dbul bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ āḥhum̐ hoḥ be tā ḍa/ bi kṛ ta mu kha/ shwa/ kā ka sū ka ra/ gṛ dhra bya ghra/ u lū ka dzaṃ bu ka ga ru ḍa mu khe bhyaḥ i daṃ/ ba liṃ/ gandhaṃ/ puṣpaṃ/ dhū pṃ/ dī paṃ/ akṣa taṃ/ da dā ma he/ te tsā gā tya/ sa pa ri wā rāḥ shī ghraṃ/ i daṃ/ ba liṃ/ gṛhṇantu/ khā dantu/ pi bantu dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥsaṃ tṛ ptāḥsarba satwā nāṃ/ shāntiṃ/ puṣṭiṃ/ rakṣa a wa ra ṇa/ guptiṃ/ kurbantu/ hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ badzra dha ra ā dzñā pa ya ti swā hā/ zhes pas dbul lo// de nas so so'i bstod pa ci shes pas bstod nas/ phrin las bcol la/ slar yang mchod de/ so so'i sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ muḥzhes brjod nas gshegs su gsol lo// gtor ma'i cho ga'o// kha zas za ba'i tshe/ kha zas gtor ma bzhin byin gyis brlabs la/ lte ba nas gtum mo'i me sbar bas lus gang ba'i me'i khrod du lus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams gsal btab nas lag pa gnyis dgang blugs dang*/ kha hom khung du dmigs te thog mar zas kyi phud kyis phyi rol du lha dang bla ma mchod nas gnod sbyin ma 'phrog ma dang bu lnga brgya la chang bu sbyin no// de nas lus kyi lha tshogs mchod pa'i bsam pas zos pa'i mthar/ lhag ma rnams lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po rnams la sbyin no// zas kyi cho ga'o// de nas spyod lam la 'jug pa'i tshe rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dag pa dran par byas la/ rigs drug dang yan lag drug gi go bgos nas phyi'i snod dag pa gzhal yas khang dang*/ bcud dag pa lha'i tshogs dang 'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad mchod pa'i rdzas su dmigs pa bdag dang snod bcud kyi lha rnams la mchod par bsam zhing*/

lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las thams cad phyag rgya dang*/ sngags dang*/ ting nge 'dzin du shes par byas la thams cad kyis kyang stong pa nyid kyi ngang nas zung du 'jug par spyad do// spyod lam mo// de nas nub mo nyal ba'i tshe/ rang gi snying ga nas spros pa'i 'od zer gyi snang ba bsdus pas snod rnams rang gis bsgoms pa'i gzhal yas khang la bstim/ bcud rnams lha rnams la bstim mo// lha rnams rang gi lus la gshegs su gsol bar bya ste/ gtsug tor du rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsgoms pa la bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo'i mtshan ma rnams gshegs su gsol lo// de bzhin du snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i lte bar rdo rje rtse dgu pa bsgoms la/ du ba ma la sogs pa'i lha mo bcu dang dpral bar lhan cig skyes pa'i 'khor lo la rdo rje rtse mo bcu bdun pa bsgoms pa'i lte bar rigs lnga dang*/ yum lnga dang*/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lor rdo rje rtse mo sum cu so gsum pa bsgoms pa'i lte bar sems dpa' drug dang*/ sems ma drug dang*/ khro bo bzhi bsdu bar bya'o// de nas rang gi lus kyang thugs ka'i hūm̐ la bsdus nas hūm̐ nam mkha' la 'ja' tshon yal ba ltar stong pa nyid du gyur pa'i ngang la nyal lo// nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ro// nang par gnyid sad pa'i tshe hūm̐ zhes brjod pas chos kyi sku stong pa nyid kyi ngang las gzugs kyi sku dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i rnam par bzhengs la/ dang po gang du bsdus pa'i gnas rnams las lha rnams spros nas/ lus kyi cha shas thams cad las rten gyi dkyil 'khor spro bar bya'o// de nas gzhal yas khang pa las snod kyi 'jig rten dang lha rnams las bcud kyi 'jig rten spros pas thams cad kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur pas/ nam mkha'i khams gang bar bltas la/ oṃ su bi shuddha'i sngags kyis nga rgyal bsgom par bya'o// ldang ba'i rnal 'byor ro// de nas khrus byed pa'i tshe/

nam mkha' na bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha rnams kyis ye shes kyi chus khrus gsol bas dri ma thams cad sbyang bar bsam zhing bkru'o// khrus kyi bya ba'o// de nas gong du bstan pa'i tshul gyis mnyam par gzhag pa'i rnal 'byor la 'jug par bya'o// de ltar rgyun du rnal 'byor du byed pa ni ring por mi thogs par rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur ro// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs/ slob dpon sā dhu pu tras mdzad pa'i gzhung dang*/ bla ma dam pa'i man ngag la brten nas/ bdag nyid kyis bsgom sla ba'i ched du chos rje sa skya paṇḍi ta'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa 'phags pas me pho stag gi lo/ smin drug gi zla ba la dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen por bsdebs pa'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
